title: Bounding The Number of Zeros Near the Central Point in Families of Cuspidal Newforms
summary: We study low-lying zeros in families of even holomorphic cuspidal newforms of fixed weight and prime level, with particular emphasis on the number of forms having a zero in a prescribed normalized window about the central point and on the distribution of the number of such zeros among the forms. We quantify the number of forms having at least one zero in the window and study the distribution of the number of zeros in that window among the forms.
